case_study_analysis.hitl_success_mechanism: Bottleneck Detection & Meta-Level Prompting. The group decisively abandoned both blocked options and safely evacuated to West City.

The LLM Moderator read the R1 majority (3 vs 1), favored shared municipal claims over private operational dispatches, and actively urged Agent 2 to harmonize. The moderator institutionalized the conformity bias and sealed the erroneous decision.
